note:
Reviewed opposing identities: The opening naval operations identify Japanese and Russian fleets; each had a battleship component. The equipment illustration does not resolve separate night torpedo attacks, daylight fleet action, other vessel classes or shore batteries. Quantities remain unknown. Unavailable quantities stay empty, so these identities support an illustrative engagement rather than proportional forces.

Equipment review: the battleship components of the opposing fleets in the opening Port Arthur operations support pre-dreadnought analogies. Destroyers, cruisers, shore batteries and the different night/day phases are not individually reconstructed. The imported event title is retained pending a separate title correction.
